overview_description.description:
Dingdong Maicai is a fresh vegetable e-commerce platform that is dedicated to accelerating production through technology. Its platform provides a service model that includes direct procurement at the point of origin, pre-warehouse distribution, and home delivery in 29 minutes or less. It was upgraded to give users a fresh food consumption experience with a specific quality, time, and category.

Dingdong Maicai was established in May 2017 and provides services in Shanghai, Beijing, Shenzhen, Hangzhou, Suzhou, and other cities.
